text: HarnessMate 是将本机 DSH Agent 接入 HarnessMate 手机应用和浏览器入口的插件。它通过 WebSocket 网关接收远程消息，再把内容交给 DSH 会话处理并流式回传回复。用户可以从手机或网页与本机 Agent 对话、双向传送文件，并在移动端处理 Agent 的授权请求。它按对话线程复用会话，支持用户回答 Agent 提出的问题。适合希望在离开电脑时继续访问本机 DSH 的用户。使用前需要 HarnessMate agent 的 botId 和 botKey，并连接 HarnessMate 网关。

HarnessMate connects a local DSH agent to its phone app and browser. Messages pass through a WebSocket gateway into a DSH session, and replies stream back. Users can chat remotely, transfer files, and respond to agent approval requests. A HarnessMate botId and botKey are required.
想在手机上继续使用电脑里运行的 DSH Agent。
I want to chat with my local DSH agent from a browser when I am away.
HarnessMate 的功能「远程对话与文件传输」：手机或浏览器消息会进入本机 DSH Agent 会话，回复可流式返回；会话中的文件可上传供手机获取，入站文件会下载后交给 Agent。授权请求也会发送到远端供用户响应。
HarnessMate 使用前须知：消息经 HarnessMate 网关传输，文件会上传至平台 API 或从消息链接下载；网关认证使用 botKey。（见 index.js:79-84、cordis.patch.yml:19-22）

harness-mate README · Introduction：`harness-mate` is a [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (`dsh`) plugin. It connects the DSH agent running on your machine to **[HarnessMate](https://github.com/liaosiliangCodeLife/harness-mate-plat)** — a small self-hostable platform that gives that agent a phone app and a browser entry.

The agent keeps running on your own computer, with your files and your approvals. HarnessMate is just the door: open it from the phone in your pocket or from a browser anywhere.

harness-mate README · What it does：- **Chat from anywhere.** Send the agent a message from the phone app or the web UI; streamed replies arrive with a typing indicator.
- **Files both ways.** Send the agent files from the phone; the agent can send files back.
- **Approvals on your phone.** When the agent asks to run a risky tool, the request is pushed to you — approve or deny from the chat, instead of being tied to the computer.
- **Keeps your machine in charge.** Tools run locally with your permissions, under your DSH profile. HarnessMate never executes anything on its own.
- **Model-agnostic and profile-aware.** It talks to whatever model your DSH profile is configured with.
- **macOS and Windows.**

harness-mate README · Install：You need a HarnessMate agent — a `bot_id` and a `bot_key`.
Open the platform (`https://harness.alltman.com` by default), sign in, go to **个人空间 → 创建智能体**, and copy both values. **The key is shown only once.**

> DeepSeek Harness desktop **v0.2.0-rc.2 or newer**, started at least once, is required.

harness-mate README · Option A — install as a plugin (recommended)：```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:liaosiliangCodeLife/harness-mate-dsh
```

Once the package is on npm this shortens to `dsh plugin --profile web add harness-mate`.

harness-mate README · Option B — run the installer：Download the release zip, unpack it, and run the installer in the plugin folder. It registers the plugin, links it into the profile, writes your credentials, and backs up the previous config — 3 steps, no manual editing.

```bash

harness-mate README · macOS：cd harness-mate
./install.sh            # or: ./install.sh <bot_id> <bot_key>
```

```powershell

harness-mate README · Windows：powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

harness-mate README · Both options finish the same way：**Quit DeepSeek Harness completely** (menu bar / tray icon → Quit — not just close the window) and start it again. Then send the agent a message from the phone app or the web UI: **a reply means it works.** Logs are written to `~/.harness-mate-trace.log` (`%USERPROFILE%\.harness-mate-trace.log` on Windows).

Detailed instructions, FAQ and the full configuration reference: **[INSTALL.md](INSTALL.md)**.

text: harness-mate README · Configuration：Every field lives under `config` in the plugin's `cordis.patch.yml`; change them and restart DSH.

harness-mate README · Configuration：| field | default | meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `gatewayUrl` | HarnessMate's gateway | The WebSocket gateway the plugin connects to |
| `botId` / `botKey` | — | This agent's identity on the platform (**required**) |
| `workspace` | your home directory | Root directory the agent may read and write |
| `dmPolicy` | `open` | `open` · `allowlist` (with `allowFrom`) · `disabled` |
| `approvalTimeoutMs` | `300000` | Tool-approval timeout; a timeout is treated as a denial |
| `apiBaseUrl` | derived from `uploadUrl` | Platform HTTP API root (incl. `/api`) for approval polling |
| `internalToken` | — | Must match platform `INTERNAL_TOKEN`; without it polling is disabled |
| `agentId` | — | Agent UUID; defaults to lookup by `botId` |
| `maxReplyChars` | `4000` | Maximum length of a single reply |
| `forwardReasoning` | `false` | Also forward the agent's reasoning to the chat |
